summary: ZenaTech, Inc. filed a Form 6-K press release announcing that it signed a binding agreement to acquire a Brisbane-headquartered Australian land surveying and spatial services firm (35-year-established). Terms include no stated price, premium, or advisors; it is the 22nd DaaS acquisition, subject to regulatory approvals. The target has three offices in Queensland and serves government/infrastructure clients. The deal expands ZenaTech's AI drone platform into Asia-Pacific. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and integration into the DaaS network; no risk-arb spread available due to undisclosed terms.
